name: Mike Dattolo
positioning: 3D Printing & Prototyping | CAD | Physical Product Development
intro: I’m Mike Dattolo, an Integrated Product Design graduate with hands-on experience supporting prototype builds, preparing fabrication files, and troubleshooting equipment. I’m interested in helping teams build, test, and improve useful physical products.
availability: Seeking a full-time role in additive manufacturing, prototyping, CAD, or physical product development in New Jersey.

experience.title: Special Operations Specialist
paragraphs: I set up and operate spooling, printing, and cutting equipment according to work orders, material requirements, and order specifications.
My work includes installing, connecting, adjusting, and troubleshooting production equipment while following quality, documentation, and safety requirements.

experience.title: Innovation Lab Technician
paragraphs: I supported student and faculty prototype builds using 3D printers, laser cutters, vinyl cutters, and CNC workflows. I prepared fabrication files, adjusted machine settings, and resolved design or equipment issues affecting output quality.
I also trained students and new employees on equipment operation, safety procedures, and lab standards.

experience.title: Retail Sales Manager
paragraphs: I led sales-floor operations, coached associates, resolved customer issues, and prepared sales and inventory reports. This experience supports the communication and training side of my technical work.
